description: Contract v1.0 — the JSON body of a [JARVIS-TASK] email. Validate before sending; the bridge rejects anything that fails this schema at intake.

acceptance_criteria.description: Discrete verifiable pass/fail statements, not one blob.

contract_version.description: Contract version this task was written against, e.g. "1.0".

do_not_touch.description: Paths the executor must never modify. Always includes the bridge installation itself.

executor.description: Which on-PC agent runs the task. Unknown values are rejected.

goal.description: Full executor instructions. MUST end with the exact sentence 'Report back with the exact result subject: [JARVIS-RESULT] <task-id>.'
goal.pattern: Report back with the exact result subject: \[JARVIS-RESULT\] [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\.$

mode.description: "agent" = full shell + file access (required for real work). Anything else is restricted.

report_back.description: WHAT content to report. Never email-sending instructions; the bridge owns delivery.

screenshot.description: Attach a PNG screenshot as proof. False only for pure headless probes.

task_id.description: Unique id, lowercase letters/digits/hyphens. Echoed exactly in the result subject.

timeout_minutes.description: Hard backstop for the run. Missing or out of range = intake rejection.

workspace.description: Absolute working path on the target PC, namespaced under the bridge task area.

title: Jarvis Bridge task email body
